limits: All five are local same-layer source candidates; no new connection is treated as human confirmed.
L1/L2 local gaps do not establish full-net separation. Connections can exist via other ends or layers.
P4/P5 extend beyond old native y3000 scope. Do not force these into the old780x1240 canvas, shrink the run, or silently change existing coordinates.
Original approximate L1/L2 endpoints are locators, not measured metal boundaries. The native endpoint windows govern this review.
